comparisons.reason: Both are binary any-comment features over the same sources, but the qualifying predicate differs. Feature 0 requires a relatable personal experience explicitly set against or countering the OP's view. Feature 1 requires a concrete personal anecdote that illustrates real-world consequences of the OP's claim, with no requirement that it be used as a counter. An anecdote of consequences could support the OP, and a contrasting experience need not show consequences. Feature 0 also has no 'concrete/specific' requirement, while feature 1 does. These are different constructs and eligibility rules.
